text:
ellie: Kickoff: social cadence + influencer outreach for the benchmark webinar next Tues. Need short copy, influencer ask templates, paid/organic split, and engagement owners.

ryan: thumbs up. i can draft influencer DM and 2 headline variants. who is curating the influencer list?

aisha: i've pulled a starter list: 8 infra/ML folks, 3 platform engineers, 2 analysts. will share handles in a sec. recommendation: pick 3 for primary outreach (higher follow counts) and 3 secondary.

tom: timeline check — assets ready by Friday? we need hero + benchmark snapshot and a 15s reel for socials. also want a static carousel for LinkedIn with 3 slides: top stat, what we changed, how to reproduce.

ellie: yes, Friday EOD for assets. visual brief: single slide with bar chart comparing median p50 latency across model+quant configs, second slide briefly lists config bullets, third slide CTA to register. primary hashtag: #ServeSmarter.

ryan: copy short (for X): "Benchmarking open models for inference cost & latency. We share configs, scripts, and lessons in our webinar. Register -> [short link] #ServeSmarter"

ryan: copy long (LinkedIn): "Running fair, reproducible inference benchmarks matters. We measured latency, token-cost, and throughput across model families and serving configs — and we'll show the exact changes that improved tail latency in production. Join our webinar to get the artifacts + live Q&A. Register: [link]"

aisha: influencer DM draft: "Hey {name}, we're running a short webinar on inference benchmarks next week. Would you be open to co-posting a short plug or quote? We can provide suggested copy and an asset pack. Happy to pay a small fee for amplification. LMK — Aisha (Redwood)"

ellie: love that. add a line offering an exclusive snippet (one stat) they can use as a hook. increases conversion.

ryan: suggested hook snippet for DM: "Top stat: Q8+KV caching reduced median latency by ~35% on our standard workload."

tom: paid plan: $600 total split across LinkedIn (sponsored reminder) and X (promoted tweet). target: infra engineers, ML infra, platform teams. run Wed-Thu leading up to webinar. cpus/roles targeting ok?

aisha: yes. growth-bot: confirm budget availability?

growth-bot: Growth budget check: $600 request queued — approve or reject via /approve-growth.

ellie: i'll /approve-growth after final copy lock. scheduling: wave 1 teaser Mon 10:00 PT X + LinkedIn, wave 2 mid-week reminder Wed 12:00 PT X thread + LinkedIn single post, day-of: 90m + 15m. same as prev but different times to avoid overlap with other launches.

ryan: thread plan for X (3 tweets + image):
1/ Headline + short stat + CTA
2/ One-sentence methodology + link to repo
3/ Speaker callout + register link + speaker handles
Keep each tweet punchy, add image on tweet 2.

aisha: tracking: use UTM pattern: utm_campaign=webinar_jun2026&utm_source={platform}&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}. also add hidden field lead_source=social_{platform}_jun2026 in the form.

ellie: engagement playbook: owner posts official, influencer reposts within 2 hours where possible, community manager (tom) does initial replies for first 6 hrs, then sales follow-ups routed for leads with company emails.

ryan: can we create 3 quick reply templates for CM to use? short ones for questions like "where's the replay", "who are speakers", "is this free".

ellie: yes. Tom can curate and add them to the scheduler notes.

tom: will do. templates: "Replay link will be shared 24h after — sign up to get it", "Speakers: @speakerA & @speakerB — both infra leads", "Free to attend — register here: [link]"

aisha: influencer priority: @infra_jane, @ml_ops_guy, @platengineer. i'll DM primary list and cc PR for any paid partnerships.

growth-bot: Reminder set: assets due Fri 17:00 PT. DM outreach to start Mon morning. Paid campaign to be toggled Wed morning.

ellie: final checklist: Ryan = final X thread + LinkedIn copy (Mon AM). Tom = reply templates + schedule notes (Thu). Aisha = influencer DMs + handle list (Mon). I'll approve budget and confirm scheduler not to auto-post until assets present. everyone ok?

ryan: ok. I'll post copies here once ready.

aisha: sending handles in a separate DM thread.

tom: noted, will coordinate CM standby on day-of.

ellie: thanks team — reopening this thread Tue morning for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
